verses.text: The LORD’s word came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
“I will sweep everything off the face of the earth,” says the LORD.
“I will sweep away people and animals, the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea. I will bring down the wicked along with their idols, and cut off humanity from the earth,” says the LORD.
“I will stretch out my hand against Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem. I will wipe out what remains of Baal from this place, along with the name of the idolatrous priests.
“I will judge those who worship the stars from their rooftops, those who worship the LORD and swear by him while also swearing by Malcam,
and those who have turned away from following the LORD, who no longer seek him or ask for his guidance.
“Be quiet before the Lord GOD, because the LORD’s day is near. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice and set apart his guests.
“On the day of the LORD’s sacrifice, I will punish the officials, the king’s sons, and everyone dressed in foreign clothes.
“On that day I will punish everyone who jumps over the threshold and fills their master’s house with violence and deception.
“On that day,” says the LORD, “a cry will rise from the Fish Gate, wailing from the Second Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.
“Wail, you who live in Maktesh! The merchants are wiped out; everyone who weighs out silver is cut off.
“At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those settled into complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD won’t do anything, good or bad.’
“Their wealth will be looted and their houses left in ruins. They will build houses but never live in them; they will plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
“The great day of the LORD is near—approaching fast. The sound of the day of the LORD is bitter; even a mighty warrior cries out then.
“That day will bring wrath, distress, anguish, trouble, ruin, darkness, gloom, clouds, and deep shadow.
“It will be a day of trumpet blasts and battle cries against fortified cities and their tall towers.
“I will bring such distress on people that they will grope around like the blind, because they sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust, and their bodies like dung.

“Their silver and gold won’t rescue them on the day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole land will be consumed by the fire of his jealousy. He will bring a complete, terrible end to everyone living in the land.”
